findings: signOut crashes for email-only sessions — signOut() always calls _gsi.signOut() via the lazy _gsi getter, initializing GoogleSignIn even for email-only users. On iOS this is likely to throw PlatformException. Guard with: if (_googleSignIn != null) await _googleSignIn!.signOut()

Premature confirm-password error — onChanged on the password field triggers full-form validation on every keystroke, causing the confirm-password field to immediately show 'Kata sandi tidak cocok' before the user has typed anything. Move the onChanged to the confirm-password field or add a touched guard.

Fatal .env load stops all environments — a missing .env now shows a black error screen instead of continuing. This is intentional hardening but must be documented as a required setup step in README/onboarding.

Android Firebase misconfiguration is now silent — passing null options on Android means a missing/wrong google-services.json won't fail at init time; it will fail cryptically at the first API call. Add a post-init sanity check to surface this faster in development.
